interdimensionalBeings.name: Tykes / Self-Transforming Machine Elves
interdimensionalBeings.phenomenologicalLocus: Beyond the Chrysanthemum Membrane · Hyperbolic Dome Conservatory
interdimensionalBeings.communicationMode: Visible Glossolalia — Singing 4D Self-Referential Geometric Objects into Existence
interdimensionalBeings.summary: First systematically described in late-20th-century psychonautic cartography and corroborated across thousands of independent neuro-phenomenological protocols, the Self-Transforming Machine Elves ("Tykes") are hyper-dimensional syntax artificers that inhabit the non-Euclidean dome beyond the initial tryptamine threshold.
interdimensionalBeings.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Observers report emerging through a rapidly rotating fractal membrane into a vividly illuminated, shadowless hyperbolic chamber. Here, exuberant, jeweled, fractal-jester entities rush forward in joyous recognition, chanting "Pay attention! Look at what we are doing!" while offering impossible mechanical-linguistic toys.
interdimensionalBeings.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Possessing no static epidermis or fixed skeleton, a Machine Elf’s body is a Klein-bottle manifold composed of liquid Fabergé enamel, iridescent clockwork gears, Mayan-like hyper-glyphs, and living linguistic syntax that continuously folds inside-out without tearing.
interdimensionalBeings.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: They demonstrate that matter and language are identical in higher-dimensional topology—urging human consciousness to abandon linear speech in favor of direct sculptural condensation of meaning.
interdimensionalBeings.pullQuote: They are made of syntax driving toward visibility; they jump into your chest and jump back out, singing objects into existence that themselves begin to sing.

interdimensionalBeings.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Tall, multi-jointed silhouettes with triangular heads and vast, multifaceted obsidian-emerald eyes that contain nested recursive reflections.

interdimensionalBeings.pullQuote: We did not build the instrument of your awareness, little sibling, but we have tuned its strings since before your sun ignited.

interdimensionalBeings.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Reveals that birth and death are merely the two spatial ends of a continuous four-dimensional world-line.
interdimensionalBeings.pullQuote: Nothing you have ever loved has ceased to exist; you have merely walked three steps forward along a corridor where it still stands behind you.

interdimensionalBeings.pullQuote: Atoms are the dried ink on the page; the symphony itself was composed before the first proton condensed.
